title: Plumbing Repair
seoTitle: Plumbing Repair Auckland | Emergency Plumber | KA Plumbing LTD

heroHeadline: Fast, Reliable Plumbing Repairs Across Auckland
heroSubheadline: From burst pipes to leaking taps — Kurt gets it sorted fast so you can get back to normal.
introHeading: Auckland's Go-To Plumber for Fast, Permanent Repairs
longDescription:
When something goes wrong with your plumbing, you need it fixed fast — not in a few days, not after three phone calls, but now. KA Plumbing provides reliable plumbing repair services across all of Auckland, from the North Shore to South Auckland.

Kurt is a fully certified plumber who arrives equipped to handle the most common plumbing repairs in a single visit. Whether you're dealing with a burst pipe flooding your kitchen in Takapuna, a persistently dripping tap in Glenfield, or a toilet that won't stop running in Devonport, the diagnosis is accurate and the fix is permanent.

Our plumbing repair services cover leaking pipes and joints, burst pipes and water main repairs, dripping and faulty taps, running or blocked toilets, water pressure issues, shower and bath repairs, washing machine and dishwasher connections, and general plumbing maintenance.

Every repair comes with honest, upfront pricing — you'll know the cost before any work begins. No call-out fees for standard repairs, and 24/7 availability for genuine emergencies.
includes: Burst pipe and water main repairs

commonIssues.issue: Burst pipe flooding your home
commonIssues.detail: Kurt arrives within 30-60 minutes, locates the burst, isolates the water supply, and completes the repair — often in a single visit.

commonIssues.issue: Tap that won't stop dripping
commonIssues.detail: A dripping tap wastes thousands of litres a year and usually needs a washer, cartridge, or mixer replacement. Quick, affordable fix.

commonIssues.issue: Toilet running constantly
commonIssues.detail: Running toilets spike your water bill fast. Typically caused by a worn inlet valve or flush mechanism — diagnosed and repaired on the spot.

commonIssues.issue: Low water pressure throughout the house
commonIssues.detail: Could be a faulty pressure-reducing valve, corroded galvanised pipes, or a Watercare supply issue. Kurt diagnoses the root cause before recommending a fix.

commonIssues.issue: Blocked or slow-draining sink
commonIssues.detail: Kitchen and bathroom blockages from grease, hair, or soap buildup. Cleared professionally without damaging your pipes.

commonIssues.issue: Leaking pipes inside walls
commonIssues.detail: Hidden leaks cause mould and structural damage. Kurt locates the leak, accesses the pipe with minimal wall damage, and repairs it permanently.

customerPromise: Every plumbing repair starts with a free, no-obligation assessment. Kurt explains what's wrong in plain language, tells you the cost before any work begins, and only proceeds when you're comfortable. There are no hidden fees, no upselling, and no pressure. If a repair isn't worth the cost, Kurt will tell you honestly. Your home is treated with respect — drop sheets go down, mess gets cleaned up, and you get a workmanship guarantee on every repair.

faqs.q: How fast can you respond to a plumbing emergency in Auckland?
faqs.a: For emergencies like burst pipes or flooding, Kurt aims to arrive within 30-60 minutes across Auckland, including the North Shore, Central, and West Auckland.

faqs.q: Do you charge a call-out fee for plumbing repairs?
faqs.a: No call-out fee for standard plumbing repairs during business hours. Emergency after-hours callouts may have a small surcharge, always disclosed upfront.

faqs.q: Can you repair all types of pipes?
faqs.a: Yes — copper, PEX, polybutylene, galvanised, and PVC. Kurt carries common fittings on the van for fast same-day repairs.

title: Hot Water Systems

title: Drain Laying
seoTitle: Drain Layer Auckland | Certified Drain Laying Services | KA Plumbing LTD
seoDescription: Certified drain layer in Auckland. Stormwater, wastewater, new drainage, and repairs. Council-compliant work across the North Shore and all Auckland. Free quotes.
heroHeadline: Certified Drain Laying Services Across Auckland
heroSubheadline: As a certified drain layer, Kurt is licensed to design, install, and repair drainage systems that meet council requirements.
introHeading: Licensed Drain Layer — Compliant, Consented, Built to Last
longDescription:
Drainage work is one area where cutting corners costs you dearly. As a certified drain layer, Kurt is fully licensed to design, install, and repair stormwater and wastewater drainage systems that meet Auckland Council requirements.

Whether you're developing a new section in Albany, replacing old clay pipes in Devonport, adding drainage to a renovation in Takapuna, or dealing with a blocked drain in Glenfield, KA Plumbing has you covered. Every drain laying job is properly documented, inspected, and built to code — protecting your property and keeping you compliant.

Our drain laying services include new stormwater and wastewater drainage installation, replacement of old clay, earthenware, and concrete pipes, drainage for new builds and subdivisions, drainage modifications during renovations, blocked drain clearing and diagnosis, CCTV drain inspection and reporting, and soak pit and stormwater management solutions.

Kurt's dual certification as both a plumber and drain layer means your project needs only one contractor. That means fewer scheduling conflicts, better coordination, and lower costs. From small residential repairs on the North Shore to large-scale drainage work across Auckland, the standard of work is always the same — council-compliant, properly consented, and built to last.

commonIssues.issue: Tree roots blocking your drain lines
commonIssues.detail: One of the most common drainage problems in Auckland. Roots find cracks in clay pipes and grow inside, causing recurring blockages. Kurt locates and removes the intrusion, then repairs or replaces the affected section.

commonIssues.issue: Old clay or earthenware pipes collapsing
commonIssues.detail: Pre-1980s Auckland homes often have clay drain pipes that crack and collapse over time. Kurt replaces damaged sections with modern PVC for a permanent fix.

commonIssues.issue: Stormwater flooding your property
commonIssues.detail: Inadequate or blocked stormwater drainage causes pooling and flooding. Kurt designs and installs proper stormwater solutions including new drains, soak pits, and channel drains.

commonIssues.issue: New build requires drainage installation
commonIssues.detail: Full stormwater and wastewater drainage for new builds and subdivisions. Designed to council specifications, installed to code, and inspected before backfill.

commonIssues.issue: Sewage smell coming from drains
commonIssues.detail: Usually indicates a cracked pipe, failed trap, or poor ventilation. Kurt diagnoses with CCTV inspection and fixes the root cause — not just the symptom.

commonIssues.issue: Renovation needs drainage modifications
commonIssues.detail: Adding or moving a bathroom during a renovation requires drainage rerouting. Kurt handles this as a certified drain layer — no second contractor needed.

customerPromise: Drain laying work is disruptive by nature — it often involves excavation. Kurt minimises the impact by planning the work carefully, using the least invasive approach possible, and restoring your property when the job is complete. Every drain laying project includes proper documentation for Auckland Council, photo records of the work, and a compliance certificate. You'll know exactly what's happening, what it costs, and when it'll be done — before any digging starts.

faqs.q: What's the difference between a plumber and a drain layer?
faqs.a: A plumber handles water supply and internal waste pipes. A drain layer handles external drainage — stormwater and wastewater systems outside the building. Kurt holds both certifications.

faqs.q: Do I need council consent for drainage work?
faqs.a: Most drainage work in Auckland requires a building consent. As a certified drain layer, Kurt handles the documentation and ensures all work meets Auckland Council requirements.
Yes — from simple blockages to complex root intrusion. We also offer CCTV drain inspections to identify the exact cause before any digging.
